tools.name: find_birth_place
tools.title: Find birth place
tools.description: Look up a birth place and return candidate matches with latitude, longitude and IANA timezone. Use it when a place name is ambiguous (e.g. "Springfield") so you can confirm the right one with the user, then pass its coordinates to the chart tools.

query.description: City or town, ideally with region/country, e.g. "Pune, India".

tools.name: calculate_natal_chart
tools.title: Calculate Vedic natal chart
tools.description: Calculate a Vedic (sidereal, Lahiri) natal chart from birth date, time and place: ascendant, the nine grahas with sign, degree, nakshatra, pada, whole-sign house and retrograde flag, a house-by-house table, and a North Indian ASCII chart. Always use this instead of estimating planetary positions yourself. Nothing is stored.

time.description: Local clock time of birth as written on the birth record, 24-hour HH:MM (e.g. 06:40). Don't convert to UTC — the timezone, including historical daylight saving, is applied for you. If unknown, use 12:00 and set time_is_approximate.

place.description: Birth city with region/country, e.g. "Pune, India". Geocoded automatically. Omit if passing latitude and longitude.

latitude.description: Birth latitude in decimal degrees (north positive). Use with longitude instead of place.

longitude.description: Birth longitude in decimal degrees (east positive).

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone of the birth place, e.g. Asia/Kolkata. Resolved from the coordinates when omitted.

time_is_approximate.description: True if the birth time is a guess. Adds a caveat about the ascendant and houses.

tools.name: get_dasha_timeline
tools.title: Get Vimshottari dasha timeline
tools.description: Calculate the Vimshottari dasha timeline from birth details: the current mahadasha and antardasha with exact dates, every antardasha in the current mahadasha, and all mahadashas across the lifetime. Use this for questions like "what period am I in?" or "when does my Saturn dasha start?". Nothing is stored.

time.description: Local clock time of birth as written on the birth record, 24-hour HH:MM (e.g. 06:40). Don't convert to UTC — the timezone, including historical daylight saving, is applied for you. If unknown, use 12:00 and set time_is_approximate.

place.description: Birth city with region/country, e.g. "Pune, India". Geocoded automatically. Omit if passing latitude and longitude.

latitude.description: Birth latitude in decimal degrees (north positive). Use with longitude instead of place.

longitude.description: Birth longitude in decimal degrees (east positive).

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone of the birth place, e.g. Asia/Kolkata. Resolved from the coordinates when omitted.

time_is_approximate.description: True if the birth time is a guess. Adds a caveat about the ascendant and houses.

as_of.description: Date to evaluate the current period at (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

tools.name: get_transits
tools.title: Get Vedic transits
tools.description: Calculate sidereal planetary positions right now or on a date, plus that day's tithi, paksha, weekday ruler and moon phase. If birth details are included, transits are also placed in the natal houses and matched against the natal chart: planets transiting over natal planets, Vedic aspects (graha drishti) onto natal houses, Sade Sati status, and the current mahadasha and antardasha. Pass user_timezone. Nothing is stored.

on.description: Transit date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the user's timezone. Omit for right now, which is the most precise for the fast-moving Moon. A given date is computed at 12:00 local time.

user_timezone.description: IANA timezone where the user is now (not their birth place), e.g. America/Los_Angeles. Sets what "today" means and the local noon used for a given date. Defaults to UTC, so pass it whenever you know or can infer it.

time.description: Optional. Local clock time of birth as written on the birth record, 24-hour HH:MM (e.g. 06:40). Don't convert to UTC — the timezone, including historical daylight saving, is applied for you. If unknown, use 12:00 and set time_is_approximate.

place.description: Optional. Birth city with region/country, e.g. "Pune, India". Geocoded automatically. Omit if passing latitude and longitude.

latitude.description: Optional. Birth latitude in decimal degrees (north positive). Use with longitude instead of place.

longitude.description: Optional. Birth longitude in decimal degrees (east positive).

timezone.description: Optional. Optional IANA timezone of the birth place, e.g. Asia/Kolkata. Resolved from the coordinates when omitted.

time_is_approximate.description: Optional. True if the birth time is a guess. Adds a caveat about the ascendant and houses.
